svg.title: Geometric mean by a semicircle
svg.desc: A semicircle has diameter AB of length 5. P divides it with AP=4 and PB=1. The perpendicular from P meets the semicircle at T, where PT=2. Triangle ATB is right at T; the altitude PT forms similar triangles and satisfies PT²=AP·PB. Taking one segment as the unit constructs a square root.
